title: Siam City Cement and B.Grimm Power start commercial operation of solar plant
summary: Siam City Cement and B.Grimm Power start commercial operation of solar plant
body_markdown: **Thailand:** Siam City Cement and B.Grimm Power have started commercial operation of a 84MW solar project at the Tabkwang Plant in Amphor Kangkoy, Saraburi. B.Grimm Power holds a 25% stake in the project and Siam City Power, a subsidiary of Siam City Cement, holds a 75% stake, according to Kaohoon International. The unit is intended to meet demand for electricity in industrial manufacturing processes, strengthen energy security and sustainably enhance energy efficiency. A groundbreaking ceremony for the project was held mid-2024.
